intent: Delete a spam-flagged post from an already silenced author.
actions: As a moderator, open the pending spam review for a hidden post whose author has already been automatically silenced for that same post.
Inspect the review and Timeline & notes, scrolling to frame them.
Open the author’s user card and inspect the silence and its reason.
Dismiss the user card, open the Yes menu, and choose Delete post.
Wait for the review to update, then inspect Timeline & notes.
